name: avm
description: Agent Virtual Machine — multi-tenant Rust runtime for AI agents. gRPC control plane, NATS JetStream job bus, PostgreSQL state, process-pool execution, MCP gateway, OTel instrumentation.

patterns.layout: Cargo workspace, one crate per component
patterns.state: PostgreSQL 16 via sqlx (runtime queries, embedded migrations)
patterns.observability: tracing + tracing-subscriber; OTLP export behind the `otlp` feature
patterns.scope_model: system -> tenant -> project -> agent; readers see own scope + ancestors

services.avm-server: gRPC control plane: TenantService, AgentService, JobService, MemoryService
services.avm-scheduler: reconciler: re-publish queued jobs, quota gate, reap stale runs, purge expired memories
services.avm-executor: JetStream pull consumer + bounded process pool (fork/exec agents)
services.avm-gateway: HTTP MCP tool routing (local handlers + upstream proxy)
services.avm-cli: operator CLI binary `avm` (migrate, submit, job, jobs, memories)
